# monit24_account_user (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# A second login for the SAME account (distinct from monit24_subaccount,
# which creates a separate, dependent account).
resource "monit24_account_user" "colleague" {
  name     = "Jane's colleague"
  username = "jane-colleague"

  user_data {
    email_address = "colleague@example.com"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `user_data` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--user_data))
- `username` (String)

### Optional

- `disable_legacy_notifications` (Boolean)
- `is_read_only` (Boolean)
- `language_id` (String)
- `package_id` (Number)
- `password` (String, Sensitive)
- `time_zone_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_activated` (Boolean)
- `is_blocked` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedblock--user_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user_data`

Required:

- `email_address` (String)

Optional:

- `address` (String)
- `contact_person` (String)
- `ip_whitelist` (List of String)
- `ip_whitelist_enabled` (Boolean)
- `phone_number` (String)
- `tax_identification_number` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import monit24_account_user.colleague 123456
```
